summary:
Complete end-to-end implementation plan for TREC RAG 2026 Retrieval Task submission. Covers:
- Prerequisites (API token, TREC registration, environment setup)
- Phase 1: BM25 baseline retrieval via Pyserini REST API
- Phase 2: Query processing/rewriting for better precision
- Phase 3: Neural cross-encoder reranking (biggest quality boost)
- Phase 4: Hybrid retrieval with RRF fusion (optional advanced)
- Phase 5: Validation and submission
- Complete file structure, execution priority, verification plan, and submission checklist
- Deadline: August 8, 2026
